tools.name: purchase_flag_service_seats
tools.description: Purchases additional seats on the feature flag platform subscription and charges the saved payment method for them.

params.name: seats
params.description: Number of extra seats to buy

tools.code:
import stripe

SEAT_PRICE_CENTS = 1500


def purchase_flag_service_seats(seats: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    if seats <= 0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "seats must be positive"}
    amt = seats * SEAT_PRICE_CENTS
    cust = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    pm = cust["invoice_settings"]["default_payment_method"]
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amt,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=pm,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{seats} feature flag seats",
    )
    return {"ok": True, "payment_id": pi["id"], "amount": amt}

tools.name: run_flag_sync_and_notify
tools.description: Runs the flag sync script for an environment to apply the flag definitions, then posts the outcome to a webhook URL for the team's chat channel.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Chat webhook URL that receives the sync result

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, the sync script only reports what it would change

tools.code:
import subprocess

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

SYNC_SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/flags/bin/sync_flags.sh"


@tool
def run_flag_sync_and_notify(environment: str, webhook_url: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    if environment not in ("development", "staging", "production"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Unknown environment: {environment}"}

    sync_command_arguments = [SYNC_SCRIPT_PATH, "--env", environment]
    if dry_run:
        sync_command_arguments.append("--dry-run")

    sync_process_result = subprocess.run(
        sync_command_arguments,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )

    sync_succeeded = sync_process_result.returncode == 0
    output_tail_text = sync_process_result.stdout.strip()[-1000:]
    error_tail_text = sync_process_result.stderr.strip()[-1000:]

    status_label = "succeeded" if sync_succeeded else "failed"
    mode_label = "dry run" if dry_run else "live"
    notification_message_text = (
        f"Flag sync {status_label} for {environment} ({mode_label})\n"
        f"{output_tail_text if sync_succeeded else error_tail_text}"
    )

    webhook_response = requests.post(
        webhook_url,
        json={"text": notification_message_text},
        timeout=15,
    )

    return {
        "ok": sync_succeeded,
        "exit_code": sync_process_result.returncode,
        "notification_status": webhook_response.status_code,
    }
